correctness_basis: GSM8K same 20 questions: baseline and DSpark 19/20; user accepts correctness and does not require token identity
reuse: previous 2K/256 eager baseline and DSpark data on same GPUs/model/source retained as references; new compiled modes measured independently
ttft_definition: client request start to first nonempty content SSE
tpot_definition: (SSE DONE timestamp - first nonempty content timestamp)/255
summary: median of three measured samples; startup, compilation, capture, warmup, profiler excluded
method: shorter block + M16 MoE/router scoped implementation; no package version or remote writes
baseline: fresh k3_bf16; previous best k3_FULL remains reference

phase_reuse.old_latency: retain as historical reference; new three-sample blocks for baseline and candidates
phase_reuse.hardware_calibration: reuse compute-reference2 and dual-rank collective references
phase_reuse.raw_shape_trace: reuse old NONE geometry; fresh profiled request is independent of timing samples
phase_reuse.accuracy: new serial GSM8K20 per candidate, no response reuse

optimization_boundary: Markov weights/sampling; baseline main/draft architecture and scoring retained
